label: The codex fallback text is generated: its single hand-authored source is hook-registry.json:23 (runtimes.codex.defaultMessage), rendered into all eighteen envelope-fallback .codex/hooks.json entries by sync-hook-registrations.cjs, with pre-commit:272 and CI:161 running the synchronizer --check; the clone probe at HEAD 82a71c87 exits 0.

The codex fallback names a tool that cannot address the failure class it accompanies: install-codex-hooks.mjs only reconciles the user-global ~/.codex/hooks.json and never builds dist or restores adapters; devin's default names 'npm run build in the spec-kit runtime package' while claude/cursor name a rebuild direction, so codex alone is misaligned.

Smallest fix: edit the one registry string and regenerate .codex/hooks.json via sync-hook-registrations.cjs; the existing gates confirm consistency. Per-binding message overrides exist (5 uses, incl. the [codex-hooks] installer notice) but are not earned for this fix; direct edits of the generated file fail pre-commit/CI --check.

Decision: codex notice alignment is a separate one-string companion fix (F7b), not part of F7; both share the root cause that nothing on the documented path builds runtime/dist. Rank F7 first, F7b immediately after; bundle in one implementation pass.
The four runtime hook registration files are generated from hook-registry.json and kept in step by --check gates in both pre-commit and CI; the clone probe PASSes at HEAD 82a71c87.
Codex's runtime-level fallback advice names the user-global hook installer, which cannot rebuild dist or restore an adapter; the advice is attached to every codex envelope binding.
A generated fallback's advice should name a remedy that can address the failure class the fallback reports.
